content.comment_body: Hello, Can anyone say if this model [article_no] includes an RTC and Astronomical clock? I've checked the manual but can't find this information.
All [product_name] [article_no] versions include an RTC and Astronomical Clock. Your [product_name] is the current [version_no] version.
You can also find this information in the manual. See the attached [document].
So, am I correct in thinking that my [article_no] model does not have an RTC or astronomical clock? Would I need to buy a [article_no] version?

That's not quite right. Review the file that [user_name] shared. The part you have is a newer generation than the one referred to as "[version_no]". You'll find the necessary instructions in the software—make sure you select the correct hardware version there. Do you know how to specify your hardware version in the software? The reliability of the RTC is another topic worth discussing. For more detailed information, check the System Manual for the [product_name].

analysis.insight_summary: Users express confusion about the hardware version and which features are integrated, namely the RTC and astronomical clock. Unclear documentation and inconsistent product naming seem to make it hard for users to know exactly what their device offers and which version they possess. The discussion briefly touches on questions regarding RTC reliability, but does not explore it in detail.
analysis.user_expectations: Users want straightforward documentation that clearly lists the features available for each [product_name] version. They also expect version names and feature differences to be transparently explained.
